climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A Western Australian zone containing Peel, Perth Hills and Swan District. Sauvignon Blanc leads plantings. Western Australia makes less than 5 percent of the country's wine.
